W.note: A pastel mint, lavender and peach halo blooms behind the button over about 480 ms after a 60 ms delay and clears in 180 ms, the most ethereal hover of the four, with a focus state, reduced-motion path and contrast readout.

X.note: The dark lavender halo, sweep and lift feel atmospheric, but enter and leave share one 560 ms curve, focus gets only an outline with no hover parity, and the page is an off-brief music player.

Y.note: The most polished product page with a sheen and focus parity, but 700 to 1200 ms transitions on background, filter and shadow make the button feel laggy and the saturated fill is less ethereal.

Z.note: Asymmetric 300 ms arrival and 170 ms leave curves, a delayed glow and a transform and opacity build make it the most practical and crisp, but the solid indigo face and faint halo read as tidy rather than dreamlike.
